steps.blackKeys: Look at the black keys: they come in groups of two and groups of three, all along the keyboard. These groups are your map.
steps.whereIsC: {c} is the white key just to the left of each group of two black keys. There is one in every group.
steps.findCs: Play every {c} on the screen keyboard, from the lowest to the highest.
steps.middleC: The {c} closest to the middle of the piano is called middle {c}. It’s your home base: most of your first songs start around it.
